# Three recorded beech pages (fn-157 R1, R2)

`tests/aggregate.rs` reads these pages through a replay adapter. They are the
Firecrawl answers the beech's run of 2026-09-25 (fn-149) received for the
WSU heritage-tree page (one 'Riversii' beech: a 171.6-inch trunk, about 125
ft, an 85 ft spread), the NC State plant page (its "Leaf Length" and "Leaf
Width" both 3-6 inches, the length read as a width that day) and the van den
Berk nursery page, trimmed then to the passages that run quoted
(`tape_trim`). They were `tests/fixtures/replay/european-beech/tape` until
fn-157 recorded the beech again; the labels the test reads are the labelled
set's (`data/cases/label.json`), so no Jev answer is kept here.
